title: Unit price discounts
statementMd:
For lines where the paid unit price is below the list price, show order id, product name and the discount percentage rounded to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `order_id`, `name`, `discount_pct`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT oi.order_id, p.name, ROUND(100.0 * (p.price - oi.unit_price) / p.price, 1) AS discount_pct FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.unit_price < p.price;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
